name: branch-commit
description: Return a branch name and concise commit message (max 3 lines) for the current task, grounded in the real `git diff`; with `--apply`, create the commit after showing the staged diff. Use when the user only needs quick branch and commit naming before committing, PR packaging is unnecessary, and a real diff exists; use `--apply` when the closure floor needs a commit. Do not use when a full PR package is needed (use pr-package), there is no diff yet, or the diff is too unclear.
